0.original: Debroye is in a state of despair.

1.original: Debroye has tasked you with crafting pinches of ascorbic additive.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Minimum collectability rating for this delivery is 160. Delivering items with a rating of 340 or more will earn greater rewards.

2.original: You deliver the ascorbic additive to an ecstatic Debroye. The current incarnation of Mervynbread is a delectable success, and she insists that you be in attendance when the Forum is ready to make their evaluation.

24.original: Deliver pinches of ascorbic additive to Debroye.

49.original: I've been trying and trying to make that ascorbic acid.

50.original: I've done exactly as Jalvaaz instructed, followed his steps to the letter, but it all ends in failure.

51.original: As embarrassing as it is to admit, I simply lack the expertise─the process requires a far more competent hand than mine.

52.original: So, here I am at the last, asking for your help once more...

53.original: Please, I need you to manufacture the additive that will perfect our perfect meal!

55.original: All our Mervynbread needs is a viable ascorbic additive. I may have failed in that endeavor, but I have faith that you will succeed!

56.original: Ascorbic acid created from plain old coconut milk... I understand the idea in practice, but as you saw, the process itself was beyond my abilities. Thank you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

57.original: Incredible─it's practically glowing with goodness! With this added to our creation, I have every confidence that the bread will pass any test they care to subject it to!

58.original: With your additive, well, added to the mix, I put a batch of Mervynbread into the oven to bake. It should be ready any moment now!

59.original: This is it─the final, fluffy result of much trial and error.

67.original: Like streams of flavor, blending into a single river of ambrosial delight!

70.original: It's like biting into a soft-baked cloud!

71.original: It's like natural law has been suspended to create this one moment of unparalleled, puffy-crusted bliss!

72.original: Fantastic! And last but not least, what did you think of the aroma?

74.original: That luscious, savory smell is to die for!

75.original: It's like a siren scent of savory temptation which no mortal stomach can resist!

76.original: Exactly what I thought! All the disparate elements have come together so well...

77.original: Flavor, texture, aroma─not to mention a perfect balance of nutrients.

78.original: And I have you to thank for this delectable achievement!

79.original: Yes, I believe this current incarnation of Mervynbread has a good chance of swaying the Forum in our favor. You <hex:021A020203>are<hex:021A020103> attending the evaluation, aren't you? In fact, I must insist upon it!

80.original: Debroye is thrilled with your efforts. She now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Consummate Baker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

81.original: The next request will be available from Debroye upon reaching level 90 as an alchemist or culinarian.
